businesses.name: Manufacturing
businesses.description: Industrial Manufacturing encompasses the design, production, and delivery of automation systems, electrification solutions, and smart infrastructure components for factories, buildings, transportation, and urban environments.

businesses.name: Chemical Mfg
businesses.description: Chemical Manufacturing is a foundational industry producing a wide range of chemicals, plastics, performance materials, and agricultural solutions used across automotive, construction, electronics, and consumer goods sectors.

businesses.name: Semiconductors

businesses.name: Automotive
businesses.description: Automotive is a major manufacturing industry producing cars, trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles along with hybrid and electric powertrains, connected mobility services, and autonomous driving technologies.

businesses.name: Construction
businesses.description: Construction is a global engineering and building industry delivering large-scale infrastructure, energy, and commercial projects including highways, airports, bridges, power plants, and residential developments.
